title: Cover letter
description: Shape of applications/<slug>/cover-letter.json. The letterhead comes from the baseline resume header, so it cannot drift from the resume. body is an array of paragraphs, which leaves nowhere to put a bullet list.

role.description: Exact title from the posting. Used in the Re: line and the PDF filename.

greeting.description: Defaults to 'Hello,'. Use the hiring manager's name only when the posting gives it.

signature.description: Defaults to the name on the resume.
